articles.title: English hospitals aim to ramp up use of robotics in surgery
articles.titleCn: 英国医院旨在加大机器人手术使用力度
articles.summary: The UK government has announced plans to invest more in robotic equipment for English hospitals and set a target for robotic assistance to be used in 90% of keyhole surgeries carried out in England by 2035
articles.summaryCn: 英国政府计划增加对机器人手术设备的投资，目标到2035年使90%的微创手术使用机器人辅助，以提升手术精度、缩短恢复时间并缓解医疗系统压力。

paragraphs.en:
The UK government has announced plans to {{1}} more in robotic equipment for English hospitals and set a {{2}} for robotic assistance to be used in 90% of {{3}} surgeries carried out in England by 2035. The government highlighted robotics as one of five "big bets" in a 10-year health plan for England, alongside other {{4}} technologies: data, AI, genomics and wearables. Surgeons and nurses using the new Da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system while performing surgery, at St Bartholomew's Hospital in London. /Carlos Jasso/AFP
At St Bartholomew's Hospital in central London, visiting surgeons are among the first to be trained to use the new da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system, made by US company Initiative. The system, which includes three robotic arms that can hold surgical equipment, is controlled using an {{5}} 3D headset and a video-game-like {{6}}.
paragraphs.cn: 英国政府宣布计划增加对英格兰医院机器人设备的投资，并设定目标，到2035年使英格兰90%的微创手术使用机器人辅助。政府将机器人技术列为英格兰十年健康计划中的五大“重大赌注”之一，其他变革性技术包括数据、人工智能、基因组学和可穿戴设备。外科医生和护士在伦敦圣巴塞洛缪医院使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统进行手术。/Carlos Jasso/AFP

paragraphs.en:
Robotic surgical systems like this can be used across a range of {{7}} including urology, gynecology, abdominal, colorectal, and thoracic or general surgery. Sasha Stamenkovic (C) using the new Da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system while performing lung cancer surgery as Ali Ansaripour (R), senior cardiothoracic trainee on a robotic fellowship, looks on. /Carlos Jasso/AFP
The {{8}} of robotic-assisted surgery should mean shorter hospital stays and quicker recovery times, which will take {{9}} off a struggling health service with year-long waitlists, workforce shortages and discharge {{10}}. "The ability to have lots of {{11}} computer-aided technology on top" of human-controlled robotics "makes this precise surgery. It makes it safe surgery," says Sasha Stamenkovic, Director of Robotic Surgery and Research at Barts Health NHS Trust.
paragraphs.cn: 在伦敦市中心的圣巴塞洛缪医院，来访的外科医生是首批接受使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统培训的人员之一，该系统由美国公司Initiative制造。该系统包括三个可持手术器械的机械臂，通过沉浸式3D头戴设备和类似视频游戏的控制台进行操作。

paragraphs.en:
As well as improving recovery times, the greater precision also reduces the risk of {{12}} like air leaks, a common cause of longer hospital stays following lung surgery. Nurses assisting in lung cancer surgery using the new Da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system, at St Bartholomew's Hospital. /Carlos Jasso/AFP
Ian Macleod was the first patient in Britain's NHS to undergo lung cancer surgery using the new da Vinci robotic system. Macleod says he "didn't realize" until he was wearing a surgical gown and anesthetised that he would hold this {{13}} title, but the news "didn't {{14}}" the 76-year-old retired detective. Thirty minutes after the robotic-assisted operation, Macleod was back on his feet.
paragraphs.cn: 此类机器人手术系统可用于多种专科，包括泌尿科、妇科、腹部、结直肠、胸外科或普外科。Sasha Stamenkovic（中）使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统进行肺癌手术，Ali Ansaripour（右）是机器人专科的高级心胸外科受训者。/Carlos Jasso/AFP

paragraphs.en: "It was extraordinary," he says. "In fact, after the operation, I found out quite quickly that I only had one stitch." He had undergone non-robotic keyhole surgery for a different cancer in the past, and says the recovery time was "much longer". This time, he was driving his wife to the garden centrer for coffee less than a week later. Stamenkovic runs fellowships at St Bartholomew's training surgeons on this new technology. He says it is the young surgeons who pick up the new robotic control system the fastest and who become the most {{15}}.
paragraphs.cn: 机器人辅助手术的精准性应能缩短住院时间和加快恢复速度，这将缓解一个面临一年等待名单、劳动力短缺和出院瓶颈的艰难医疗系统的压力。“在人类控制的机器人技术之上，拥有大量集成计算机辅助技术的能力，使这种手术变得精准。它使手术安全，”巴特健康NHS信托机器人手术与研究主任Sasha Stamenkovic说。

paragraphs.en:
"They've come with different skill sets," he says, "they've probably come with gaming skill sets, some of them have come with a musical background."
Laying out his long-term mission, Stamenkovic added: "All we need to do is harness their energy, their passion, their skill set, and teach them the right moves. And that will make the surgeon of the future."
paragraphs.cn: 除了改善恢复时间外，更高的精准度还降低了并发症的风险，如空气泄漏，这是肺手术后住院时间延长的常见原因。护士在圣巴塞洛缪医院使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统协助肺癌手术。/Carlos Jasso/AFP

articles.fullText:
The UK government has announced plans to invest more in robotic equipment for English hospitals and set a target for robotic assistance to be used in 90% of keyhole surgeries carried out in England by 2035.
The government highlighted robotics as one of five "big bets" in a 10-year health plan for England, alongside other transformative technologies: data, AI, genomics and wearables.
Surgeons and nurses using the new Da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system while performing surgery, at St Bartholomew's Hospital in London. /Carlos Jasso/AFP
At St Bartholomew's Hospital in central London, visiting surgeons are among the first to be trained to use the new da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system, made by US company Initiative. The system, which includes three robotic arms that can hold surgical equipment, is controlled using an immersive 3D headset and a video-game-like console.
Robotic surgical systems like this can be used across a range of specialties including urology, gynecology, abdominal, colorectal, and thoracic or general surgery.
Sasha Stamenkovic (C) using the new Da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system while performing lung cancer surgery as Ali Ansaripour (R), senior cardiothoracic trainee on a robotic fellowship, looks on. /Carlos Jasso/AFP
The precision of robotic-assisted surgery should mean shorter hospital stays and quicker recovery times, which will take strain off a struggling health service with year-long waitlists, workforce shortages and discharge bottlenecks.
"The ability to have lots of integrated computer-aided technology on top" of human-controlled robotics "makes this precise surgery. It makes it safe surgery," says Sasha Stamenkovic, Director of Robotic Surgery and Research at Barts Health NHS Trust.
As well as improving recovery times, the greater precision also reduces the risk of complications like air leaks, a common cause of longer hospital stays following lung surgery.
Nurses assisting in lung cancer surgery using the new Da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system, at St Bartholomew's Hospital. /Carlos Jasso/AFP
Ian Macleod was the first patient in Britain's NHS to undergo lung cancer surgery using the new da Vinci robotic system. Macleod says he "didn't realize" until he was wearing a surgical gown and anesthetised that he would hold this groundbreaking title, but the news "didn't faze" the 76-year-old retired detective.
Thirty minutes after the robotic-assisted operation, Macleod was back on his feet. "It was extraordinary," he says. "In fact, after the operation, I found out quite quickly that I only had one stitch." He had undergone non-robotic keyhole surgery for a different cancer in the past, and says the recovery time was "much longer". This time, he was driving his wife to the garden centrer for coffee less than a week later.
Stamenkovic runs fellowships at St Bartholomew's training surgeons on this new technology. He says it is the young surgeons who pick up the new robotic control system the fastest and who become the most adept.
"They've come with different skill sets," he says, "they've probably come with gaming skill sets, some of them have come with a musical background."
Laying out his long-term mission, Stamenkovic added: "All we need to do is harness their energy, their passion, their skill set, and teach them the right moves. And that will make the surgeon of the future."
articles.fullTextCn:
英国政府宣布计划增加对英格兰医院机器人设备的投资，并设定目标，到2035年使英格兰90%的微创手术使用机器人辅助。政府将机器人技术列为英格兰十年健康计划中的五大“重大赌注”之一，其他变革性技术包括数据、人工智能、基因组学和可穿戴设备。外科医生和护士在伦敦圣巴塞洛缪医院使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统进行手术。/Carlos Jasso/AFP

在伦敦市中心的圣巴塞洛缪医院，来访的外科医生是首批接受使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统培训的人员之一，该系统由美国公司Initiative制造。该系统包括三个可持手术器械的机械臂，通过沉浸式3D头戴设备和类似视频游戏的控制台进行操作。

此类机器人手术系统可用于多种专科，包括泌尿科、妇科、腹部、结直肠、胸外科或普外科。Sasha Stamenkovic（中）使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统进行肺癌手术，Ali Ansaripour（右）是机器人专科的高级心胸外科受训者。/Carlos Jasso/AFP

机器人辅助手术的精准性应能缩短住院时间和加快恢复速度，这将缓解一个面临一年等待名单、劳动力短缺和出院瓶颈的艰难医疗系统的压力。“在人类控制的机器人技术之上，拥有大量集成计算机辅助技术的能力，使这种手术变得精准。它使手术安全，”巴特健康NHS信托机器人手术与研究主任Sasha Stamenkovic说。

除了改善恢复时间外，更高的精准度还降低了并发症的风险，如空气泄漏，这是肺手术后住院时间延长的常见原因。护士在圣巴塞洛缪医院使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统协助肺癌手术。/Carlos Jasso/AFP

Ian Macleod是英国NHS中第一位使用新型达芬奇机器人系统进行肺癌手术的患者。Macleod说，直到他穿上手术服并被麻醉时，他才“意识到”自己将拥有这一开创性的头衔，但这一消息“没有吓到”这位76岁的退休侦探。机器人辅助手术后三十分钟，Macleod就重新站了起来。

“这太非凡了，”他说。“事实上，手术后，我很快发现我只有一针缝合。”他过去曾因另一种癌症接受过非机器人微创手术，并表示恢复时间“长得多”。这次，不到一周后，他就开车带妻子去花园中心喝咖啡。Stamenkovic在圣巴塞洛缪医院开展奖学金项目，培训外科医生使用这项新技术。他说，年轻外科医生最快掌握新的机器人控制系统，并成为最熟练的人。

“他们带来了不同的技能组合，”他说，“他们可能带来了游戏技能，有些人有音乐背景。”

在阐述他的长期使命时，Stamenkovic补充说：“我们只需要利用他们的能量、他们的热情、他们的技能组合，并教他们正确的动作。这将造就未来的外科医生。”

articles.title: Europe faces record heat, drought and water-related pressures
articles.titleCn: 欧洲面临创纪录高温、干旱和水资源压力
articles.summary: Europe faces record heat, drought and water-related pressures
articles.summaryCn: 欧洲正经历极端高温和干旱，导致河流水位下降、野火频发，并对农业和能源系统造成严重影响。

paragraphs.en: Europe is experiencing a summer of extreme heat and {{18}}, with record temperatures, wildfire risks and falling river levels affecting several countries. A {{0}} landscape in the wake of a wildfire that swept through the Gironde region in Lege-Cap-Ferret, southwestern France, August 4, 2026. France recorded its hottest July since nationwide records began in 1900, with a monthly average temperature of 24.9 degrees Celsius, according to Meteo-France. Rainfall across the country was nearly 70% below the seasonal average, making July 2026 the third-driest July on record. Persistent heat, drought and windy conditions kept wildfire risks high or very high, while a wildfire in the southwestern department of Gironde burned about 42,000 hectares and forced the {{1}} of more than 220,000 people. Boats lie in the dried out {{16}} of a branch of the river Danube in Hainburg, Austria, August 3, 2026.
paragraphs.cn: 欧洲正经历一个极端高温和干旱的夏季，创纪录的气温、野火风险和下降的河流水位影响了多个国家。2026年8月4日，法国西南部莱格-费雷角地区，一场野火席卷吉伦特地区后留下焦土。据法国气象局称，法国录得自1900年全国记录开始以来最热的七月，月平均气温为24.9摄氏度。全国降雨量比季节平均水平低近70%，使2026年7月成为有记录以来第三干旱的七月。持续的高温、干旱和多风条件使野火风险保持高位或极高，而西南部吉伦特省的一场野火烧毁了约4.2万公顷土地，迫使超过22万人撤离。2026年8月3日，奥地利海因堡，多瑙河一条支流的干涸河床上停着船只。

paragraphs.en: In Austria, a national temperature record of 41 degrees Celsius was set on Tuesday as the heat wave continued. The record was measured in the Stammersdorf region of Vienna, according to Austria's state broadcaster ORF. A forest fire is also {{15}} in Burgenland, while the Lobau wetlands in Vienna face the highest fire danger level. Meanwhile, water levels on the Danube River have fallen to historically low levels, {{3}} to the major low-water years of 2003 and 2018. The dried-up Danube riverbed with the Paks power plant at the background, near Dunaszentbenedek, close to Paks town, Hungary, July 31, 2026. Neighboring Hungary has {{4}} its highest-level heat alert until midnight on Friday as {{17}} show the heat wave will continue.
paragraphs.cn: 在奥地利，随着热浪持续，周二创下了41摄氏度的全国气温纪录。据奥地利国家广播公司ORF报道，该纪录是在维也纳的施塔默斯多夫地区测得的。布尔根兰州也发生森林火灾，而维也纳的洛鲍湿地面临最高火灾危险等级。与此同时，多瑙河水位已降至历史低位，与2003年和2018年的主要低水位年份相当。2026年7月31日，匈牙利敦森本尼德克附近，干涸的多瑙河河床，背景是帕克斯核电站。邻国匈牙利已将最高级别高温警报延长至周五午夜，因为预报显示热浪将持续。

paragraphs.en: Authorities warned that {{2}} high temperatures could affect everyone and urged people to take {{5}}. The heat wave has {{6}} drought conditions, lowered water levels in major rivers and increased wildfire risks, with firefighters recently responding to around 100 outdoor fires per day. A firefighting helicopter flies toward a wildfire on a mountain near L'Aquila, central Italy, August 3, 2026. Italy is also facing its fourth major heat wave of the summer, with temperatures {{7}} 40 degrees Celsius in some areas. The Health Ministry placed 25 of the country's 27 {{8}} cities under the highest heat alert, including Rome, Milan, Florence, Bologna, Venice, Naples and Palermo. Hot and dry conditions have increased wildfire risks and put pressure on agriculture, with farmers reporting reduced crop yields and higher {{9}} demand.
paragraphs.cn: 当局警告说，持续高温可能影响所有人，并敦促人们采取预防措施。热浪加剧了干旱状况，降低了主要河流的水位，增加了野火风险，消防员最近每天应对约100起户外火灾。2026年8月3日，意大利中部拉奎拉附近，一架消防直升机飞向山火。意大利也面临今年夏天的第四次主要热浪，部分地区气温超过40摄氏度。卫生部将全国27个受监测城市中的25个置于最高高温警报之下，包括罗马、米兰、佛罗伦萨、博洛尼亚、威尼斯、那不勒斯和巴勒莫。炎热干燥的条件增加了野火风险，并对农业造成压力，农民报告作物减产和灌溉需求增加。

paragraphs.en: A general view of the Paks nuclear power plant, Hungary, July 31, 2026. Low river levels and rising water temperatures have also affected nuclear power operations in parts of Europe. Hungary's Paks nuclear power plant, which supplies nearly half of the country's electricity, remained {{10}} but its operation depended on river conditions and cooling system performance. Romania's Cernavoda nuclear power plant shut down both reactors after low Danube water levels affected operations. In France and Switzerland, some nuclear facilities also faced operational {{11}} as high river temperatures affected cooling {{12}}. The combination of extreme heat, drought and {{13}} water {{14}} is putting pressure on public health, agriculture, wildfire prevention and energy systems in affected areas.
paragraphs.cn: 2026年7月31日，匈牙利帕克斯核电站全景。低河流水位和上升的水温也影响了欧洲部分地区的核电运营。匈牙利帕克斯核电站供应全国近一半的电力，虽然仍在运营，但其运行取决于河流状况和冷却系统性能。罗马尼亚切尔纳沃德核电站在多瑙河低水位影响运营后关闭了两个反应堆。在法国和瑞士，一些核设施也因高河流水温影响冷却能力而面临运营中断。极端高温、干旱和水资源可用性下降的组合正在给受影响地区的公共卫生、农业、野火预防和能源系统带来压力。

articles.fullText:
Europe is experiencing a summer of extreme heat and drought, with record temperatures, wildfire risks and falling river levels affecting several countries.
A scorched landscape in the wake of a wildfire that swept through the Gironde region in Lege-Cap-Ferret, southwestern France, August 4, 2026. 
France recorded its hottest July since nationwide records began in 1900, with a monthly average temperature of 24.9 degrees Celsius, according to Meteo-France.
Rainfall across the country was nearly 70% below the seasonal average, making July 2026 the third-driest July on record.
Persistent heat, drought and windy conditions kept wildfire risks high or very high, while a wildfire in the southwestern department of Gironde burned about 42,000 hectares and forced the evacuation of more than 220,000 people.
Boats lie in the dried out riverbed of a branch of the river Danube in Hainburg, Austria, August 3, 2026. 
In Austria, a national temperature record of 41 degrees Celsius was set on Tuesday as the heat wave continued. The record was measured in the Stammersdorf region of Vienna, according to Austria's state broadcaster ORF.
A forest fire is also raging in Burgenland, while the Lobau wetlands in Vienna face the highest fire danger level. Meanwhile, water levels on the Danube River have fallen to historically low levels, comparable to the major low-water years of 2003 and 2018.
The dried-up Danube riverbed with the Paks power plant at the background, near Dunaszentbenedek, close to Paks town, Hungary, July 31, 2026. 
Neighboring Hungary has extended its highest-level heat alert until midnight on Friday as forecasts show the heat wave will continue. Authorities warned that persistent high temperatures could affect everyone and urged people to take precautions.
The heat wave has intensified drought conditions, lowered water levels in major rivers and increased wildfire risks, with firefighters recently responding to around 100 outdoor fires per day.
A firefighting helicopter flies toward a wildfire on a mountain near L'Aquila, central Italy, August 3, 2026. 
Italy is also facing its fourth major heat wave of the summer, with temperatures exceeding 40 degrees Celsius in some areas.
The Health Ministry placed 25 of the country's 27 monitored cities under the highest heat alert, including Rome, Milan, Florence, Bologna, Venice, Naples and Palermo.
Hot and dry conditions have increased wildfire risks and put pressure on agriculture, with farmers reporting reduced crop yields and higher irrigation demand.
A general view of the Paks nuclear power plant, Hungary, July 31, 2026. 
Low river levels and rising water temperatures have also affected nuclear power operations in parts of Europe.
Hungary's Paks nuclear power plant, which supplies nearly half of the country's electricity, remained operational but its operation depended on river conditions and cooling system performance.
Romania's Cernavoda nuclear power plant shut down both reactors after low Danube water levels affected operations. In France and Switzerland, some nuclear facilities also faced operational disruptions as high river temperatures affected cooling capacity.
The combination of extreme heat, drought and declining water availability is putting pressure on public health, agriculture, wildfire prevention and energy systems in affected areas.

当局警告说，持续高温可能影响所有人，并敦促人们采取预防措施。热浪加剧了干旱状况，降低了主要河流的水位，增加了野火风险，消防员最近每天应对约100起户外火灾。2026年8月3日，意大利中部拉奎拉附近，一架消防直升机飞向山火。意大利也面临今年夏天的第四次主要热浪，部分地区气温超过40摄氏度。卫生部将全国27个受监测城市中的25个置于最高高温警报之下，包括罗马、米兰、佛罗伦萨、博洛尼亚、威尼斯、那不勒斯和巴勒莫。炎热干燥的条件增加了野火风险，并对农业造成压力，农民报告作物减产和灌溉需求增加。

2026年7月31日，匈牙利帕克斯核电站全景。低河流水位和上升的水温也影响了欧洲部分地区的核电运营。匈牙利帕克斯核电站供应全国近一半的电力，虽然仍在运营，但其运行取决于河流状况和冷却系统性能。罗马尼亚切尔纳沃德核电站在多瑙河低水位影响运营后关闭了两个反应堆。在法国和瑞士，一些核设施也因高河流水温影响冷却能力而面临运营中断。极端高温、干旱和水资源可用性下降的组合正在给受影响地区的公共卫生、农业、野火预防和能源系统带来压力。

articles.fullText:
The 3rd China-West Africa Medical Summit and Expo has opened in Ghana's capital, Accra, bringing together healthcare professionals, technology companies and industry stakeholders for a three-day event focused on innovation and medical technology.
The summit comes as countries across Africa increasingly turn to digital solutions and artificial intelligence to improve healthcare delivery and address persistent challenges in the sector.
Among the exhibitors is Vincent Zhang, who is using the expo to introduce a range of AI-powered medical devices to the Ghanaian market.
Zhang says one of the devices can monitor a patient's vital signs, with artificial intelligence used to analyse the data.
"This headband is used to monitor a person's main vital signs. The data collected is then analysed using our AI system.”
Connecting hospitals through technology
Other exhibitors are looking beyond individual medical devices, focusing instead on systems that can connect healthcare facilities and improve the sharing of medical information.
Liu Xianbo, Deputy General Manager at Goldisc Healthcare, is showcasing a cloud-based platform designed to connect hospitals and clinics and bring patient records and other medical information onto a single system.
"This software we are introducing in Ghana is called the 123 program. It is one platform that more than 20 hospitals and more than 300 clinics can connect to each other.”
Dozens of Chinese companies are taking part in the expo, exploring opportunities in Ghana and the wider West African market.
From AI-assisted diagnosis to digital medical management systems, exhibitors say the technologies could help healthcare professionals make faster and better-informed decisions.
For Ghanaian health experts, however, the opportunity goes beyond showcasing new technologies.
Moving AI from exhibitions to hospitals
They say deeper China-West Africa cooperation could help move artificial intelligence from the exhibition floor into everyday healthcare, but that will require investment in skills and infrastructure.
“It's crucial that we start implementing that as early as possible because the rate at which artificial intelligence is getting into all aspects of life, not just medicine, is immense,” said Dr Edem Kojo Hadzi, a fertility specialist at Lister Hospital.
“If we don't get involved now, we would be late,” he added.
The push for greater adoption of AI comes as healthcare systems across Africa grapple with shortages of medical personnel, limited resources and growing demand for specialised services.
Experts say building local capacity will be critical to ensuring health workers can effectively develop, adopt and use AI technologies while maintaining appropriate standards of patient care and data protection.
As China and West African countries deepen cooperation in healthcare, exhibitors at the Accra summit are also looking for local partners who can help distribute their technologies across Ghana and the wider region.
The expo highlights a growing ambition to make digital innovation and artificial intelligence a more practical part of Africa's healthcare future.

articles.fullText:
Google's head of AI, Demis Hassabis, will step down from his current role to become Alphabet's chief scientist amid a reshuffling at DeepMind that will also include a key engineer's departure.
Hassabis will take on two new titles, Alphabet announced on Wednesday: chair of DeepMind and chief scientist of Alphabet.
The change "will allow me to focus on long-term strategy, and accelerating scientific breakthroughs, including leaning into my work at Isomorphic to help cure disease," Hassabis wrote in a social media post.
Isomorphic Labs is an AI-powered drug discovery lab that spun out from DeepMind in 2021. In 2024, Hassabis won a Nobel Prize in chemistry.
As part of the shake up, DeepMind's chief technology officer and chief AI architect Koray Kavukcuoglu will become the division's senior vice president and oversee its operations, including the development of Google's flagship frontier models and products which are known as Gemini.
Longtime Google engineer Jeff Dean is also leaving the company after nearly three decades to "try something new, and we're excited to support him in that," Google CEO Sundar Pichai said in a blog post announcing the news.
Hassabis co-founded DeepMind in 2010, and four years later, Google bought the research lab for $650 million, according to reports at the time. His co-founder, Mustafa Suleyman, is currently the chief of Microsoft's AI segment.
Google is competing for customers alongside other major AI developers including Microsoft, OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta, as well as DeepSeek and Moonshot in China.
The industry is also chasing a theoretical milestone known as advanced general intelligence (AGI), which is a point when AI software matches the capabilities of human thinking.
"I've been working towards AGI my whole life and now, like many of you, I feel it is close at hand," Hassabis wrote in Wednesday's blog post.
"With this backdrop, I've decided that now is the right time for me to hand over my day-to-day operational responsibilities at (Google DeepMind), so that I have the time and space to focus on the big picture and help influence what is to come," Hassabis continued.
Observers have been waiting for Google to announce a more powerful version of its AI model, called Gemini 3.5 Pro, which was supposed to launch in June but appears to be delayed.
Its shares closed 4% down Wednesday afternoon.
The leadership changes come amid a wider brain drain at Google.
In June, a top AI and engineering executive, Noam Shazeer, left for OpenAI, while senior researcher John Jumper, who shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in chemistry with Hassabis, jumped to Anthropic.

谷歌AI负责人德米斯·哈萨比斯将卸任当前职务，成为Alphabet的首席科学家，与此同时DeepMind进行重组，一位关键工程师也将离职。Alphabet于周三宣布，哈萨比斯将担任两个新职务：DeepMind主席和Alphabet首席科学家。哈萨比斯在社交媒体帖子中写道，这一变动“将使我能够专注于长期战略，并加速科学突破，包括深入我在Isomorphic的工作以帮助治愈疾病。”Isomorphic Labs是一家AI驱动的药物发现实验室，于2021年从DeepMind分拆出来。2024年，哈萨比斯获得了诺贝尔化学奖。

作为重组的一部分，DeepMind的首席技术官兼首席AI架构师科拉伊·卡武克乔卢将成为该部门的高级副总裁，并负责其运营，包括开发谷歌旗舰前沿模型和产品，即Gemini。谷歌长期工程师杰夫·迪恩在近三十年后也将离开公司，以“尝试新事物，我们很高兴支持他这样做，”谷歌CEO桑达尔·皮查伊在宣布此消息的博客文章中表示。哈萨比斯于2010年共同创立了DeepMind，四年后，据当时报道，谷歌以6.5亿美元收购了该研究实验室。他的联合创始人穆斯塔法·苏莱曼目前是微软AI部门的主管。谷歌正与其他主要AI开发者竞争客户，包括微软、OpenAI、Anthropic和Meta，以及中国的DeepSeek和Moonshot。

该行业还在追逐一个理论里程碑，即高级通用智能（AGI），这是AI软件达到人类思维能力水平的一个点。“我一生都在致力于AGI，现在，像你们许多人一样，我觉得它近在咫尺，”哈萨比斯在周三的博客文章中写道。“在这种背景下，我决定现在是时候将我在（谷歌DeepMind）的日常运营职责交出去，以便我有时间和空间专注于大局，并帮助影响未来，”哈萨比斯继续说道。观察人士一直在等待谷歌宣布其AI模型的更强大版本，称为Gemini 3.5 Pro，该模型原定于6月推出，但似乎已被推迟。其股价周三下午收盘下跌4%。

领导层变动发生在谷歌更广泛的人才流失之际。6月，一位顶级AI和工程高管诺姆·沙泽尔离开去了OpenAI，而高级研究员约翰·詹珀，与哈萨比斯共同获得2024年诺贝尔化学奖，跳槽到了Anthropic。

articles.fullText:
Chinese scientists have completed a new 1:5,000,000-scale geological map of the entire moon, incorporating the latest findings from China's Chang'e lunar exploration program to provide improved scientific support for future lunar exploration and research.
According to the Institute of Geology under the Chinese Academy of Geological Sciences, which led the project, the main map measures approximately 2.8 meters in length and 1.2 meters in height. It also includes detailed geological maps of the moon's north and south polar regions.
The updated map identifies more than 13,000 impact craters and 81 impact basins, while classifying 14 types of geological structures and 17 rock types.
Based on the latest lunar exploration results, including data from the Chang'e missions, the new map features three major improvements while also enhancing both scientific accuracy and visual clarity.
The first improvement is a refinement of the moon's geological timescale. Drawing on the latest research, scientists revised the ages marking the beginning of major geological periods. The start of the Aitkenian period was adjusted to 4.33 billion years ago, the Nectarian period to 4.17 billion years ago and the Imbrian period to 3.92 billion years ago. The map also provides the first finer global subdivision of the moon's late-stage stratigraphy.
The second is an updated inventory of lunar materials. Using higher-resolution maps of key mineral distributions and revised rock classification standards, researchers identified a previously unrecognized rock type, gabbro-norite, in the South Pole-Aitken Basin based on the latest discoveries from the Chang'e-4 and Chang'e-6 missions. The finding provides a direct view of materials originating from the moon's deep interior.
The third innovation is a customized mapping standard developed specifically for the 1:5,000,000 scale. Researchers established differentiated minimum mapping units for different geological features, ensuring the map remains easy to interpret while preserving scientifically significant details.
Yang Zhiming, director of the Institute of Geology at the Chinese Academy of Geological Sciences, said the updated geological map will provide important scientific support for the construction of China's future lunar research station, the selection of lunar landing sites and future deep-space exploration missions.
He added that the new map represents China's latest contribution to humanity's understanding of the evolution of the solar system.
articles.fullTextCn:
中国科学家完成了覆盖整个月球的新1:5,000,000比例尺地质图，整合了中国嫦娥探月计划的最新发现，为未来的月球探测和研究提供了更好的科学支持。据领导该项目的中国地质科学院地质研究所介绍，主图长约2.8米，高约1.2米。它还包括月球南北极地区的详细地质图。更新后的地图识别出超过13,000个撞击坑和81个撞击盆地，同时分类了14种地质结构和17种岩石类型。基于最新的月球探测结果，包括嫦娥任务的数据，新地图具有三大改进，同时增强了科学准确性和视觉清晰度。

第一个改进是月球地质时间尺度的细化。借鉴最新研究，科学家修订了主要地质时期开始的年龄。艾托肯纪的开始调整为43.3亿年前，酒海纪调整为41.7亿年前，雨海纪调整为39.2亿年前。该地图还首次提供了月球晚期地层学的更精细全球细分。第二个是月球物质清单的更新。

利用更高分辨率的关键矿物分布图和修订的岩石分类标准，研究人员根据嫦娥四号和嫦娥六号任务的最新发现，在南极-艾托肯盆地识别出一种先前未认识的岩石类型——辉长苏长岩。这一发现提供了来自月球深部物质的直接视图。第三个创新是为1:5,000,000比例尺专门定制的制图标准。研究人员为不同的地质特征建立了差异化的最小制图单元，确保地图易于解读，同时保留科学上重要的细节。中国地质科学院地质研究所所长杨志明表示，更新后的地质图将为中国未来月球研究站的建设、月球着陆点的选择以及未来的深空探测任务提供重要的科学支持。

他补充说，新地图代表了中国对人类理解太阳系演化的最新贡献。
